description: Client-side script for 'Interview' doctype in ERPNext, managing interview scheduling, feedback, and related UI interactions.

methods.name: onload
methods.description: Initial setup when the Interview form loads, setting query for job applicants and interviewers.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the form, adds buttons for rescheduling and feedback based on status and user permissions.

methods.name: show_reschedule_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to reschedule the interview with date and time pickers.

methods.name: show_feedback_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog for submitting interview feedback, including skill assessment, result, and comments.

methods.name: get_fields_for_feedback
methods.description: Returns the fields configuration for the feedback skill assessment table.

methods.name: set_job_applicant_query
methods.description: Sets the query filters for selecting job applicants based on status and designation.

methods.name: interview_round
methods.description: Handles changes to the interview round, resets values, and updates interview details.

methods.name: set_interview_details
methods.description: Fetches and sets interviewers for the selected interview round.

methods.name: job_applicant
methods.description: Handles selection of a job applicant, ensuring interview round is selected and setting related details.

methods.name: set_designation_and_job_opening
methods.description: Fetches and sets designation, job title, and resume link based on selected interview round and applicant.

methods.name: reset_values
methods.description: Resets designation, job opening, and resume link fields.
